description: Mediation Board Commission - Mediation Boards Commission, Notice calling for Nominations for the Appointment of Mediators, Mediation Board Area Thalawakele, Norwood, Administrative District Nuwara Eliya
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to the Mediation Boards Commission. It outlines the process for submitting nominations, eligibility criteria for nominees, and the role of the Commission in the selection process. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it relates to the administration of an alternative dispute resolution body established by the Mediation Boards Act.
